## C015 Lifecycle state machines (`lifecycle.py`)

### run

| from | legal targets |
|---|---|
| created | admitted, cancelled, rejected |
| admitted | cancelled, rejected, running |
| running | awaiting_approval, cancelling, failed, succeeded, suspended |
| awaiting_approval | cancelling, failed, running, suspended |
| suspended | cancelling, failed, running |
| cancelling | cancelled, failed |
| succeeded | (terminal) |
| failed | (terminal) |
| cancelled | (terminal) |
| rejected | (terminal) |

### invocation

| from | legal targets |
|---|---|
| requested | authorized, cancelled, denied |
| authorized | cancelled, denied, dispatched, pending_approval, timed_out |
| denied | (terminal) |
| pending_approval | authorized, cancelled, denied, timed_out |
| dispatched | completed, failed, indeterminate, timed_out |
| completed | (terminal) |
| failed | (terminal) |
| timed_out | (terminal) |
| cancelled | (terminal) |
| indeterminate | (terminal) |

### approval

| from | legal targets |
|---|---|
| requested | expired, granted, rejected |
| granted | consumed, expired, revoked |
| rejected | (terminal) |
| consumed | (terminal) |
| expired | (terminal) |
| revoked | (terminal) |

Invariants enforced by `Lifecycle.transition`:

- invocation DISPATCHED requires a prior AUTHORIZED record
- invocation of a side-effecting tool reaches DISPATCHED only via PENDING_APPROVAL -> AUTHORIZED
- terminal states have no outgoing transitions
- INDETERMINATE invocations are never retried automatically
- duplicate `request_id` returns the original transition (idempotent); reuse for a different target is AGT-LCY-001
- restore replays history through the same guards (`Lifecycle.restore`)

## C016/C027 Versioning and compatibility (`compat.py`)

Component INV-69 4.3.0; protocol PK_AGENT_PEER/1.

- MAJOR: breaking wire/persisted change; MINOR: additive; PATCH: fix.
- Readers: current major + N-1 via registered migrators (`compat.migrate`); newer majors are refused.
- Writers: current major only. Peers: same protocol major, features by capability intersection.
- Deprecation stages: announce -> warn -> disable-by-default -> remove; minimum notice one minor release or 90 days, whichever is longer; security exceptions may shorten with a waiver (ops/WAIVERS.json).

| schema | major |
|---|---|
| PK_AGENT_APPROVAL | 1 |
| PK_AGENT_BACKUP | 1 |
| PK_AGENT_CONFIG | 1 |
| PK_AGENT_ERROR | 1 |
| PK_AGENT_RUN_EVENT | 1 |
| PK_AGENT_STATUS | 1 |
| PK_AGENT_STEP | 1 |
| PK_AGENT_TRANSCRIPT | 1 |

| deprecated | stage | replacement | removal |
|---|---|---|---|
| Agent.step result key 'reason' as the only failure signal | announce | result['code'] (PK_AGENT_ERRORS/1) | 5.0.0 |
| Agent.approvals direct mutation | warn | Agent.approve() | 5.0.0 |

## C019 Precedence policy (`precedence.PRECEDENCE_POLICY`)

Version PK_AGENT_PRECEDENCE/1.0.0. Order (highest first): security > legal_residency > safety > data_integrity > availability_slo > performance > cost.

Hard (never waivable): security, legal_residency, safety, data_integrity. Waivable: availability_slo, performance, cost (max 30 days).

| collision | resolution |
|---|---|
| slo_vs_approval_latency | approval wins (safety > availability_slo); run waits or fails with AGT-APR-001 |
| cost_vs_secure_sandbox | heavy tier wins (security > cost); cost budget exhaustion refuses rather than downgrades |
| failover_vs_residency | residency wins (legal_residency > availability_slo); no failover outside allowed zones |
| retry_vs_budget | budget wins (safety); retries never exceed step/cost budget or deadline |
| degraded_mode_vs_audit | audit wins (data_integrity); no audit => no execution |

## C025 Timeouts, cancellation, idempotency, backpressure (`context.py`, `retry.py`)

| operation | default budget s |
|---|---|
| authorization | 0.5 |
| policy | 0.25 |
| approval_lookup | 0.25 |
| sandbox_launch_fast | 1.0 |
| sandbox_launch_heavy | 10.0 |
| tool_execution | 30.0 |
| audit_persist | 0.5 |
| audit_export | 5.0 |
| dependency_call | 2.0 |
| overall_run | 300.0 |

| operation class | retry safety |
|---|---|
| authorization.check | idempotent |
| policy.evaluate | idempotent |
| approval.lookup | idempotent |
| sandbox.launch | idempotent |
| durable.acquire | idempotent |
| audit.persist | keyed |
| audit.export | keyed |
| durable.checkpoint | keyed |
| tool.execute.readonly | idempotent |
| tool.execute.side_effect | keyed |
| tool.execute.unknown | non_idempotent |

- Deadlines are absolute (monotonic) and child deadlines never exceed the parent.
- Cancellation propagates parent -> child. A cancel observed after DISPATCHED leaves the invocation INDETERMINATE (side effect unknown) and it is never auto-retried.
- Admission: `max_active` running, `max_waiting` bounded waiters (up to their deadline), overflow shed with AGT-CAP-003 (retryable). `reserved_critical` slots serve priority=critical only.

## C052 Health and stall detection (`health.py`)

| reason code | meaning |
|---|---|
| HLT-OK | healthy |
| HLT-STALL-WARN | a run has made no progress for longer than stall_warning_s |
| HLT-STALL-CRIT | a run has made no progress for longer than stall_critical_s |
| HLT-QUEUE-WARN | oldest admission wait exceeds queue_age_warning_s |
| HLT-QUEUE-CRIT | oldest admission wait exceeds queue_age_critical_s |
| HLT-DEP-DOWN | a critical dependency is down or stale |
| HLT-AUDIT-STALL | audit writer has not progressed |
| HLT-OFFLINE | connectivity offline; online-only capabilities blocked |
| HLT-CONTAINED | operator containment active (new runs disabled) |
| HLT-SEALED | an agent audit stream is sealed |

| condition | automatic action |
|---|---|
| warning | alert_only |
| critical_run_stall | cancel_run |
| critical_queue_age | reject_new_work |
| critical_audit_writer | reject_new_work |
| critical_dependency | reject_new_work |

Dimensions: liveness, worker_progress, queue_age, run_progress, dependency, audit_writer, sandbox_startup, approval_response. Thresholds come from `health.*` in the effective configuration; per-tool `expected_max_s` distinguishes legitimately long tools from stalls.

## C053 Retry (`retry.py`)

Full jitter `uniform(0, min(max_delay, base_delay * 2^attempt))`; max 10 attempts; never sleeps past the deadline; retry budget = 10 + 20% of first attempts (storm protection); side-effecting operations retry only with an idempotency key; every attempt is recorded (attempt, code, delay, outcome).

## C079 Telemetry policy (`telemetry.TELEMETRY_POLICY`)

| type | sensitivity | retention days | sampling | access |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| metric | low | 395 | none (aggregated) | operator |
| trace | medium | 14 | head-based, config telemetry.trace_sample_rate | operator |
| log | medium | 30 | none; rate-limited | operator |
| audit | high | 2555 | mandatory_unsampled | security+auditor |
| explain | high | 400 | mandatory_unsampled | tenant-operator |

Residency: records labelled with residency.zone are exported only to exporters in the same zone. Encryption: in transit TLS1.3 / at rest AES-256 (delegated to exporter backend; INV-47 external). Deletion: local buffers are memory-only and cleared on flush/rotation; retention hold is enforced by the backend.
